title: Premium Accounting Manual: Application of Credit Balances on Premium Billing Accounts
content:
**Clause.** A credit balance on a Premium Billing Accounts arrangement belongs to the account on which it arose.

1. *Transfer before refund.* Where the arrangement allows credit transfer and the same customer has past-due premium on another open account, the credit is applied to that past-due premium, oldest month first, before any refund is issued. On arrangements where transfer is not allowed the credit stays on its own account.
2. *Open accounts.* On an open account a credit is applied to the next invoice unless the account holder asks for a refund.
3. *Closed accounts.* On a closed account the credit balance is refunded when it is at least the arrangement's refund minimum and written off otherwise.
4. *Group arrangements.* Group arrangements refund only on closure (their refund method is credit to the next invoice).
5. *The refund.* A refund is issued by the arrangement's refund method within the arrangement's refund issue time (business days) after the credit, references the credit it pays out, and can never exceed the credit balance on the account at the time.

The arrangement's refund minimum, credit-transfer permission, refund method and refund issue time are per-arrangement figures of Premium Billing Accounts; each applies to the arrangement of the account on which the credit arose.

**Decision table (by the clauses above).**
| Situation of the credit | Treatment |
|---|---|
| The arrangement allows transfer and the same customer has past-due premium on another open account | applied to that past-due premium, oldest month first, before any refund |
| Otherwise, on an open account, the holder does not ask for a refund | applied to the next invoice |
| Otherwise, on an open account of an individual or exchange arrangement, the holder asks for a refund | refunded by the refund method within the refund issue time |
| Otherwise, on an open account of a group arrangement | not refunded while the account is open; group arrangements refund only on closure |
| Otherwise, on a closed account | refunded when at least the refund minimum, written off when below it |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A closed Cascade Individual Direct Bill Monthly account shows a credit of 12.40 and the customer has no other account with past-due premium: the credit is at least the refund minimum of that arrangement and is refunded to the method of the latest payment, the refund referencing the credit and not exceeding 12.40.
